demo.program:
# VBA — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created VBA?", "Microsoft"),
    ("What paradigm is VBA?", "procedural, OOP"),
    ("What is creator?", "Microsoft"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1993"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "procedural, OOP"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".bas"),
    ("What is hello world?", "MsgBox \"Hello, world!\""),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
